title: ant farm
pitch: a glass ant farm on your screen. drop crumbs, plan tunnels, raise a colony that digs itself deeper. watch out for the kid with the magnifying glass.
controls: feed: tap the grass to drop crumbs. dig: drag on dirt next to a tunnel to plan it. look: tap an ant to meet it. drag or scroll to move. tap the magnifying glass to shoo the kid. 1/2/3 tools, c colony, m mutes.
how_to: food becomes eggs, eggs become ants
more tunnel = more room for ants
plan tunnels toward the buried curios
at 50 ants, send a new queen flying for royal jelly

achievements.name: go away kid
achievements.desc: shoo the kid with the magnifying glass

achievements.name: long live the queen
achievements.desc: send a new queen on her nuptial flight
